svg.title: Shao–Zou: staggered bridges between four sheets
svg.desc: Construction schematic with four truncated ends, ten bridges per adjacent pair and genus twenty-seven. A cutaway exposes open necks. The plan diagram shows the half-step offset between consecutive bridge rings. Not a solved self-shrinker.

g.text: Four ends · ten necks per gap · thirty bridges · model genus 27
Front half removed: look into the gaps
Alternating neck sites, viewed from above
Gap 1 → A; gap 2 → B; gap 3 → A
The two sets are offset by π/m (half a step).
Each sheet continues to one conical end.
Outer rims and cut edges are display boundaries.
Neck widths and vertical separation are enlarged.
CONSTRUCTION SCHEMATIC · not a computed self-shrinker
Existence requires sufficiently large m for each fixed k; the displayed counts do not specify that threshold.
